meta.method: Records of the species within +-60 km of the town (a box), 1990 on, with coordinates and no geospatial issue, observations and museum specimens only (no fossil, living-specimen or material-sample records). dataPoor: fewer than 2000 fish records of any species in the box (Chordata records without a named class, which is how the GBIF backbone holds the fishes).
